channel.title: Blog — Open Agent and AI Security Community
channel.description: Announcements, release notes, and project updates from the Open Agent and AI Security Community.

item.title: Ecosystem Spotlight: CogniSafe Scores AI Safety from Observra Telemetry
item.dc:creator: Open Agent and AI Security Community
item.description: UK-based CogniSafe, an AI trust and safety platform, has adopted Observra as the telemetry layer for its runtime scoring pipeline, plugging straight into the events teams already collect instead of building its own instrumentation.

item.title: Observra 1.1: Bring Observability to Any AI Agent
item.dc:creator: Steve Wilson
item.description: Observra 1.1 opens its telemetry pipeline to any custom agent framework — no adapter required — plus local storage, a live terminal dashboard, and support for 100+ LLM providers.

item.title: Promptfall: Ten Vulnerabilities. One Hero. Zero Slide Decks.
item.dc:creator: Steve Wilson
item.description: Our newest open-source project is a browser platformer that teaches the 2026 OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, one stomped vulnerability at a time. No install, no account, no homework. Just play.

item.title: Praxen 1.2: Now Aligned to the 2026 OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
item.dc:creator: Steve Wilson
item.description: Praxen 1.2 aligns risk findings to the 2026 OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, with clearer scoring, scan-to-scan comparisons, and a new shareable Worker Remit.

item.title: When a Security Scan Earns Its Keep
item.dc:creator: Open Agent and AI Security Community
item.description: A developer building a security-sensitive AI agent put Praxen to work on their own codebase. Here's what it found, and how fast it got fixed.

item.title: Community Spotlight: It's Time for Common-Sense AI Security
item.dc:creator: Open Agent and AI Security Community
item.description: Community member Steve Wilson argues that securing AI agents doesn't call for new theory, just the basics applied properly, verifying behavior before deployment, building real audit trails, and treating agents as identities the SOC actually watches.

item.title: Community Spotlight: Connecting SAILORS to Praxen
item.dc:creator: Open Agent and AI Security Community
item.description: Community member Vinaya Vasu connects her SAILORS security framework to Praxen, showing how design-time checks and post-build verification reinforce each other.

item.title: Join Us on LinkedIn
item.dc:creator: Steve Wilson
item.description: Our LinkedIn community is live — join for release announcements, discussion, and news from the people building Observra and Praxen.

item.title: Community Spotlight: Mapping OWASP Risks with Praxen
item.dc:creator: Open Agent and AI Security Community
item.description: Community member Steve Wilson used Praxen to test 12 open-source agent projects against both the OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10 — and found the two risk taxonomies overlap more than most people expect.
